test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which is the Indian state with highest percentage of Scheduled Castes (SCs) in their population as per the Census of 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2011 census recorded nearly **20.14 crore** people belonging to various **scheduled castes** in the country.
 
• The **highest SC population, 31.9 per cent **of the state's total number, is in** Punjab**.
 
• **Lakshadweep **has the highest proportion of** STs at 94.8 per cent.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• A** census **is a survey that is conducted on all **observation objects** that are a part of a** particular population or universe.**
 
• The** first comprehensive census **was done in **1881,** but it had been conducted in India **every ten years** since **1872,** while** British Viceroy Lord Mayo** was in charge.
 
• Since **1949,** it has been managed by the **Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of Indi**a, through the **Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India.**
